# fbfast

> Read-only Firebird 5 client for Python (CPython 3.11-3.15) with a Rust core
> and the official Firebird client bundled in the wheel. One API, sync and
> asyncio, returns tuples, dicts, validated Pydantic models, native JSON bytes,
> pyarrow Tables or Polars DataFrames, materialized or streamed.

Key rules: only single SELECT/WITH statements in READ ONLY transactions (not a
sandbox: use a minimal database role); positional `?` parameters whose Python
type matches the SQL type; methods without a suffix block and `_async` methods
(plus `aclose`) are coroutines; always use context managers for pools,
snapshots, streams and query groups; UTF8 connections only; one operation at a
time per snapshot or stream; create pools after `fork()`. Reach a named pool
with `fbfast.get_pool(name)`. The installed package carries the same rules
offline in `fbfast/llms.txt`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/README.md): overview, installation, choosing a result type, async services, streams, Arrow/Polars, snapshots
- [Rules for code assistants](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/python/fbfast/llms.txt): hard rules, goal-to-method table, parameter types, defaults, errors and pitfalls in one page
- [Recipes](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/recipes.md): FastAPI with a named pool, NDJSON over HTTP, Polars/Parquet ETL, Arrow streaming, snapshot reports, Pydantic models, concurrent queries
- [Errors](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/errors.md): exception hierarchy, phases, when each error happens and whether retrying helps
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/troubleshooting.md): wire encryption, roles, charsets, parameter types, slow BLOBs over a WAN, Decimal256 in Polars, timeouts, fork safety
- [Configuration](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/configuration.md): every FirebirdConfig option with its FB_* variable and default
- [Performance](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/performance.md): latency, round trips, BLOBs, compression and when to use each output
- [API reference](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/api.md): signatures and docstrings of the public API

## Examples

- [basic_query.py](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/examples/basic_query.py): configuration from FB_* variables, fetch_val/fetch_one/fetch_all, explain, errors, stats and diagnostics
- [typed_models.py](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/examples/typed_models.py): Pydantic models with upper-case names or validation aliases, sync and async
- [concurrent_queries.py](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/examples/concurrent_queries.py): Query objects with run_all, run_many and their async forms
- [snapshot_report.py](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/examples/snapshot_report.py): consistent reads with pool.snapshot(), including a stream
- [json_stream.py](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/examples/json_stream.py): fetch_json and NDJSON streaming, sync and async
- [polars_etl.py](https://github.com/rafael-peter/fbfast/blob/v0.3.0/examples/polars_etl.py): fetch_polars to Parquet, Decimal256 handling, Arrow stream to Parquet
